parsed.internal_thinking: I have 3 VP from settlements (7, 14, 41) and 2 revealed Knight cards. I have one hidden Knight card in my hand. By playing this Knight, I will reach 3 revealed Knights, securing the Largest Army (2 VP). This brings my total to 5 VP, which is the win condition for this game. I'll move the robber to Hex 4 (Sheep 8) to target Alice, as she has 3 VP and is my closest competitor, and she has two settlements on that high-yield hex. This move secures the win immediately.
parsed.note_to_self: Playing the final Knight to claim Largest Army and reach 5 VP for the victory.
parsed.say_outloud: Alright Alice, you've been asking for a hero to move that robber. I'll take care of it and, more importantly, take the Largest Army for the win!
